description: Material inter-annotator disagreements for the 5-document ground-truth pilot, with adjudication outcomes. Both annotation passes were produced independently; see 05_ground_truth_pilot_report.md for the single-agent IAA caveat.

disagreements.reason: A two-column term/definition block with no visible ruling can be read as a list or a table.
Annotator B converted basis points to percent, changing the stated unit.
disagreements.adjudicated_result: object 100, unit basis_points; 1-percentage-point equivalence in qualifier

disagreements.annotator_b: illustrates: figure -> processing-pipeline section (caption folded into figure)
disagreements.reason: Both a caption->figure attachment and a figure->section depiction are defensible and were treated as mutually exclusive.
disagreements.adjudicated_result: keep both: annotates (caption->figure) required, illustrates (figure->section) optional

disagreements.reason: Monospaced source example; annotator B did not use the dedicated code node type.
Statutory marginal side-notes ('26 USC 55', 'Definition.') resemble footnotes but are marginal glosses.

disagreements.annotator_a: created a references edge to an external statutory-reference node (state unresolved)
disagreements.reason: Unclear whether external cross-reference targets (IRC section 55(b)) should be represented when their body is outside the document.
disagreements.adjudicated_result: represent as a node with state 'unresolved' plus the references edge

disagreements.reason: No rule for numeric normalization of grouped monetary values.
disagreements.adjudicated_result: bare digits in object; grouped form preserved in qualifier

disagreements.annotator_a: list + list_item (List of Tables reference list)
disagreements.reason: A caption reference list with dot leaders and page numbers looks tabular.
Expanding '$5.3 trillion' to full digits implies precision the source does not state.
disagreements.adjudicated_result: object 5.3, unit USD_trillion (keep the scale word)
